subject: Vulnerability closure update: authn/authz, audit-logging, outbound egress
messages:
From: Alex Hall <alex.hall@quantixhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@quantixhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quantix PT report and evidence request

Jonas —

Thanks for hosting the pen test report (attached). Our security team reviewed the findings and flagged three high-priority areas where we need remediation evidence before we can sign off:

- Authentication/authorization (several endpoints allow weak token reuse; see finding A-3)
- Audit logging completeness (missing structured audit fields for token events; see L-2)
- Outbound egress (misconfigured ACLs allow unexpected external IP ranges; see N-1)

Could you share:
1) A remediation ETA per finding (approx days/weeks)
2) A short explanation of the fix (config change, code fix, ops runbook)
3) Evidence artefacts we can validate (patch diff, config snippet, audit log sample)

We've attached the report and marked the items in a shared Drive folder. Team, let us know if we should schedule a quick screen-share next week to walk through the evidence.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Quantix is aiming to complete their vendor review by Dec 20.

—Alex
Alex Hall
Information Security Manager
Quantix Health

Attachment: quantix-pt-report-20261129.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hall <alex.hall@quantixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quantix PT report and evidence request

Alex — thanks for the report and the clear ask. We appreciate the timeline; below is our current remediation plan and ETA by finding. We attached a remediation matrix (redwood-remediation-matrix-20261202.xlsx) and placed supporting docs in the shared Drive link.

Summary (high-level):
- Authentication/Authorization (Finding A-3):
  - Fix: Rotate affected token signing keys, enforce pairwise token binding for session tokens, and add server-side reuse detection.
  - Owner: Engineering (Soojin) + Infra (Vivek)
  - ETA: 10 business days (target 2026-12-16)
  - Evidence: patch diff + config snippet + unit/integration test logs

- Audit logging completeness (Finding L-2):
  - Fix: Add structured audit fields to the auth event pipeline, wire events to the centralized ELK stream, and enable per-tenant audit retention for 90 days.
  - Owner: Platform (Marissa) + Observability (Soojin)
  - ETA: 5 business days (target 2026-12-09) — we can provide sample snippets sooner.
  - Evidence: auditlog-snippets-20261208.txt, dashboard link, and schema migration PR

- Outbound egress (Finding N-1):
  - Fix: Lockdown egress to approved CIDR ranges + apply deny-by-default egress ACLs and add egress monitoring alerting.
  - Owner: Infra (Vivek)
  - ETA: staged — initial ACL lockdown in 7 business days (2026-12-13); full mitigation (including monitoring) in 20 business days (2027-01-05)
  - Evidence: ACL diffs, iptables/sg config snippets, and post-deploy egress scan results

Next steps we propose:
1) We'll upload artifacts to the Drive folder as each item is ready.
2) Provide a short set of audit log snippets for L-2 by 2026-12-08 (so you can validate before the Dec 20 deadline).
3) Request a re-test window — please let us know preferred dates in late Dec or early Jan.

If that timeline works, we'll proceed and keep you updated with incremental evidence.

Best —
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales (Security Accounts)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-remediation-matrix-20261202.xlsx (Excel, 75KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Alex Hall <alex.hall@quantixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-04T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quantix PT report and evidence request

Alex / team —

Quick technical clarifications from engineering to align expectations:

- A-3 (token reuse): the immediate mitigation will be to enable server-side token nonce tracking and rotate the compromised signing key. That requires a rolling deploy across the session service and the auth proxy; plan is zero-downtime but does require connection draining windows (we estimate 4 hours of rolling traffic shaping across regions).

- L-2 (audit fields): we will add the following structured keys to auth events: event_id, actor_id, principal_type, resource_id, action, outcome, request_id, and token_hash_sha256. We will also include a short example in the Drive folder.

- N-1 (egress): can you confirm whether the Quantix test classified the observed IPs as destination TCP/443-only or if there were UDP flows as well? That affects the ACL language we apply (stateful vs UDP allowlist).

Inline quote for context:
> Could you share:
> 1) A remediation ETA per finding...

I'll start work on the auditlog sample today and drop a text file you can validate.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Staff Software Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Hall <alex.hall@quantixhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@quantixhealth.com
Date: 2026-12-05T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quantix PT report and evidence request

Soojin — thanks, that helps. To clarify on the egress flows: the scanner observed TCP 443 and TCP 80 to several cloud-hosted analytics IP ranges; there were no UDP flows reported. The attached report includes destination IPs in appendix B.

Given that, a TCP-only ACL deny-by-default is acceptable for our review. Please include the post-change egress scan results so we can close the N-1 item.

Also: if you can provide the audit log snippets by 2026-12-08, we'll attempt to validate and, if successful, mark L-2 as remediated ahead of the Dec 20 deadline.

—Alex
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hall <alex.hall@quantixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T15:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quantix PT report and evidence request — status and artifacts

Alex / Quantix team —

Short status update and attached evidence (see attachments and Drive):

Closed / provided as of today (2026-12-09):
- L-2 (Audit logging completeness): sample snippets uploaded (auditlog-snippets-20261208.txt) showing structured fields and a dashboard link. Schema PR: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-quantix-evidence (PR ID RDW-9876).
- A subset of low/medium auth issues (token expiry configuration) were patched and deployed; unit/integration logs included in the Drive folder.

In progress (remaining):
- A-3 (token reuse - full server-side nonce tracking and key rotation): on track for 2026-12-16. We will provide the patch diff and a short runbook demonstrating the zero-downtime rotation steps.
- N-1 (egress lockdown): initial ACL lockdown will be applied 2026-12-13; we will run a follow-up egress scan and share results (target evidence date 2026-12-14). Full monitoring/alerting rollout scheduled for 2027-01-05.

Requested next steps from Quantix:
1) Please confirm whether you want a live re-test (we can schedule a 60-minute window the week of 2026-12-20).
2) If you accept the staged egress plan, we'll prioritize ACL lockdown earlier.

Thanks again for the clear findings — we're committed to closing these before your vendor sign-off.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales (Security Accounts)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: auditlog-snippets-20261208.txt; redwood-remediation-matrix-20261202.xlsx
